text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone went wild.
Over the reunion of the two on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The continuation of an interrupted story.
Its first battle is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew...
I was pulled... strongly... toward the rear...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Me too...
Perhaps we were both just paying too much attention to each other.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither of them was able to seize victory.
That... was proof that history had begun to change.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, Uni-san, for some reason,
I don't mind it at all...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though this defeat has opened
a page within myself that I never knew existed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe is... too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I sense the 'flickering.'
With this... the stars' colors will shift...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, in this race,
Neo Universe was able to confirm the "orbit".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: We can keep going, can't we... forever, just like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry anymore.
I have completely broken free from that other universe's misfortune.
However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Negative?
At this rate... I can't go?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because there are so many "RÊVES."
Yeah, because there are so many "RÊVE"s.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path of stars stretches straight ahead.
Yet, it does not simply continue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are new encounters, and even stronger bonds
with the Umamusume met along the way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, Liebe Liebe,
it's Liebe, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really get to join in much today,
but next time~.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――? Trainer,
Zenno Rob Roy has become... an "alien lifeform".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle! Universe-chan,
I'm Hishi Miracle~! Not an alien species!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Great work out there, Hishi Miracle-san.
Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, Robroy-chan, you noticed I was in it?
Well, that makes it a little better, then~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not since last year's Takarazuka Kinen.
The child of miracles, Hishi Miracle, was
also participating in this race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hey, you two. Since we're all in the Senior Class together now and got closer like this~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I guess I just wanted to talk a bit more.
Like, uh... I was hoping we could be friends~ or something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected, that might be a little annoying, huh~?
Still, what if...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle...
That's "FELT"... isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wishes to seek "expansion."
With you too. And……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to "rival" them.
The "Great King" and the "Singularity."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Di... did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um~, is it like you wanna beat
Dai-chan or Tokui-chan?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...
That's... kind of creepy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Universe-chan seems pretty intense, but
maybe she could have a little more fun with it~
Or so I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, n-no, nothing! But, you know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let's all make it interesting! Um, the next race is~

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Next...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —The Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup... is next!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then the Japan Cup.
Me too!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no hesitation. Tokyo, 2400m on turf.
The second leg of the Senior Autumn Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My friends are here, my seniors are here,
and people all over the world are watching.
This will truly be the culmination of the reborn Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The stars... gather. The stars of "MAZN."
Neo Universe is no longer "STDA."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If we form a star cluster, we can "compete."
Against the "King" and the "Singularity." But...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Have a little more fun"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe came to "fight together."
And yet……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I sense... a fluctuation...
If there is a correction... I want to know.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Cup,
Neo Universe...
